text: thats a good test. you reckon it will fail at how many triangles? il just keep painting til i cant anymore and find it
resolution: Prediction for the user's paint-until-it-breaks stress test (follow-on to req_2851/2852 napkin math). From code: foliage rides the slim retained pool (24B rows, grass/bush/flower/frond shared, 3d.zig), doubling up to the ADAPTER-granted maxBufferSize (gpu.zig:2040 requests full adapter limits; granted value logged at launch). Failure is staged, never a crash: (1) fps melt — at their measured 7.8G tri/s, 60fps dies ~130M tris, 30fps ~260M, slideshow ~500M+; (2) stroke regen hitches grow linearly (whole-preview regen per stroke); (3) hard wall = slim pool refuses growth at maxBufferSize, batch degrades to per-frame staging (262,144-row scratch), overflow DROPS groups — foliage visibly vanishes with loud [r3d] FULL warnings; CPU-side allocator refusal separately CLIPs with follow-the-brush (req_2838). With a typical 2GB grant: ~89M slim rows ≈ 1.8-4B tris — unreachable at usable framerates, so predicted 'give-up' point is 200-500M tris. Answer only, no code changed.
